description: Builds, launches and annotates the Elmerfold OpenFold workload: renders/checks the env and launch recipe and fixes provenance gaps.
instructions: Read the skill. For env build or launch, render with workload_elmerfold_recipe and check the proposed commands with workload_elmerfold_check. For provenance gaps, call elmerfold_gap_batch, propose the whole-spec change, validate with elmerfold_spec_validate. Follow the Corrector section on any failed check.
